description: Search public posts by time range and/or keyword. ① Time only (since_hours, or since/until): returns that window as a reverse-chronological feed — use it for "what is new", "what is the community talking about today", "what was posted on 25 October". ② With keyword: ranks posts inside the window by keyword hits, most relevant first. ③ Neither time nor keyword: returns the 20 newest posts site-wide. Time parameters: since_hours=24 means the past 24 hours relative to now; since/until are YYYY-MM-DD Beijing calendar days, until is inclusive. Every result carries its real publish time — judge freshness from it and never assume the results are recent; if the window is empty, say so honestly. Difference from find_nearby: this tool searches by time and keyword across the whole site, find_nearby searches by place.

keyword.description: Keyword matched against post bodies. Omit to get the feed in reverse chronological order.

since.description: Start time, inclusive. A bare date (YYYY-MM-DD) means 00:00 Beijing time that day; a full ISO timestamp with offset also works, e.g. 2026-10-25T08:00:00+08:00.

since_hours.description: Hours to look back from now, e.g. 24 means the past 24 hours. Use either this or since; when both are given this one wins.

until.description: End time. A bare date includes the whole day, e.g. until=2026-10-25 means up to 24:00 on the 25th.

name: search_posts
title: Search Posts
